Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to

minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic End User Certificate: Wherever Bidders are insisting for End User Certificate from the Buyer, same shall be provided in Buyer’s standard format only. 4. Generic Malicious Code Certificate: The seller should upload following certificate in the bid:- (a) This is to certify that the Hardware and the Software being offered, as part of the contract, does not contain Embedded Malicious code that would activate procedures to :- (i) Inhibit the desires and designed function of the equipment. (ii) Cause physical damage to the user or equipment during the exploitation. (iii) Tap information resident or transient in the equipment/network. (b) The firm will be considered to be in breach of the procurement contract, in case physical damage, loss of information or infringements related to copyright and Intellectual Property Right (IPRs) are caused due to activation of any such malicious code in embedded software. 5. Generic IT equipment shall be IPv6 ready from day one. 6. Generic Non return of Hard Disk: As per Buyer organization’s Security Policy,Faulty Hard Disk of Servers/Desktop Computers/ Laptops etc. will not be returned back to the OEM/supplier against warranty replacement. 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Registrar payable at Gautam Buddha University . Telephone No. for Service Support. 11. Rate Contract AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 12. The OEM shall provide/support restoration of the operating system to the original fa ctory condition through OEM recovery DVD, software-based recovery or cloud-based r ecovery.

4. All products shall be supplied in sealed condition and shall be genuine, brand new, unused and of the latest stable OEM version. The offered model shall not be obsolete at the time of bid submission and shall have a minimum 5 years residual OEM sup port. 5. The bidder shall be the OEM or an authorized partner of the OEM. Ab id-specific, i nk-signed MAF on OEM letterhead shall be submitted, mentioning the GeM Bid Num ber, product name, OEM name and authorized OEM representative's official contact d etails. 6. All OEM documents shall be verifiable through the OEM's official website or official corporate email. Individual/personal email IDs shall not be accepted. 7. Minimum 36 months comprehensive on-site warranty shall be provided from t he date of installation. Defective parts/components shall be replaced free of cost durin g the warranty period. 8. If a computer remains non-functional for more than 15 days after reporting the faul t, the warranty shall be extended by the period of non-functionality beyond 15 days. 9. The bidder shall provide OEM/bidder support contact details and an escalation matr ix. 10. Each supplied device shall have a unique serial number. The buyer shall be able to verify the product's genuineness, configuration and warranty status through the OEM website. 11. A bid-specific, ink-signed technical compliance statement and exact product datash eet/specification shall be submitted on OEM letterhead, duly signed and stamped. 12. The OEM shall provide a bid-specific certificate confirming that the supplied product s are free from malicious code. 13. The bidder shall submit applicable certifications for the quoted computer/display, in cluding BIS, CE, FCC, RoHS, TCO, Energy Star, EPEAT and MIL-STD-810H, wher ever applicable/specifically required. 14. The OEM shall confirm that Windows is factory pre-loaded and genuine. The Windo ws product key shall be digitally embedded in BIOS/firmware. 15. The offered equipment shall be suitable for the environmental conditions of the inst allation site, as supported by OEM-published specifications. 16. The bidder shall possess a valid ISO 9001 certification. 17. The quoted equipment shall be delivered to the consignee location without addition al cost to the buyer. 18. The supplier shall provide the sample/demo of the quoted equipment within3 work ing days by 1300 hrs after opening of the technical bid at the location specified in t he tender. 19. The equipment demonstrated and supplied shall exactly match the configuration qu oted in the bid. Any material deviation may result in rejection during technical evaluat ion. 20. The bidder shall submit the last three financial years' turnover certificates certified

by a Chartered Accountant with membership number and UDIN and shall have positiv e net worth. 21. Bidders seeking applicable SME relaxation shall submit the required valid SME certif icate and supporting financial documents as prescribed in the tender. 22. Failure to provide repair/replacement/support within the stipulated period shall attr act action as per the tender conditions and applicable procurement rules. 1. . 17.
